passages.title: Plans for Riverside Apartments Approved
passages.body:
The Clayton City Council voted 5–2 on Tuesday to approve a 12-story apartment building on the site of the former Riverside textile mill. The project, developed by Northgate Properties, will include 180 apartments, 40 of which will be offered at below-market rents. Construction is expected to begin in the spring and to take two years.

Supporters say the project will help address the city's housing shortage. Opponents argue that the building's height will block views of the river and increase traffic on Mill Street.

passages.title: To the Editor
passages.body:
I was disappointed to read about the council's decision on the Riverside Apartments. As a resident of Mill Street for over 20 years, I have seen traffic grow steadily, and this project will only make it worse.

I am not against new housing; our city clearly needs it. But a building half the height would provide much-needed apartments without overwhelming the neighborhood. I urge the council to work with Northgate Properties on a revised design.

Gloria Mendez, Clayton

passages.title: Alpine Crest Hotel — Rooms & Rates (per night)
passages.body: All rates include breakfast. Free cancellation up to 72 hours before arrival. Guests staying three nights or more receive a complimentary spa pass.

Hello,

I'd like to book a room for my family (two adults and two children) from Friday, February 13, to Monday, February 16. We'll be cooking some of our own meals, so a kitchen would be very helpful.

Could you also tell me whether the hotel offers ski equipment rental?

Thank you,
Renata Silva

Dear Ms. Silva,

Thank you for your inquiry. I have reserved the room you need for the dates requested. As you are staying three nights, a spa pass will be included.

Regarding your question, we do not rent ski equipment ourselves, but Summit Sports, located next to our lobby, offers a 15% discount to our guests.

I look forward to welcoming you.

Tom Becker

passages.title: Torrance Medical Center — Staff Parking Update
passages.body:
Due to construction of the new outpatient wing, Lot B will close permanently on March 1. Staff currently parking in Lot B have two options:

1. Park in the new West Garage for $35 per month (a $15 increase).
2. Join our carpool program: registered carpools of three or more employees park free in reserved spaces in Lot A.

Submit the carpool registration form to the Transportation Office by February 20.

passages.title: Carpool Registration Form
passages.body: All members must work at Torrance Medical Center.

Dear Ms. Rahman,

Thank you for registering your carpool. Your group has been assigned space 12 in Lot A. Please display the attached permit on your dashboard at all times.

Note that if any member leaves your carpool, you must inform us within one week, as carpools with fewer than three members are not eligible for free parking.

Transportation Office

passages.title: Golden Fork Catering — Invoice #GF-3381
passages.body: Payment due within 14 days of the event.

Hello,

Thank you for the wonderful food at our launch event; our guests loved it.

I have one question about the invoice. We agreed in advance that there would be 70 guests, not 80, and only 65 people actually attended. Could you check the guest count and send a revised invoice? Everything else looks correct.

Best regards,
Yasmin Clarke

Dear Ms. Clarke,

Thank you for your kind words. You are correct: our contract states 70 guests, and the invoice should reflect that number. As per our policy, we charge for the confirmed guest count rather than for actual attendance.

A revised invoice is attached; the balance due is now $1,410. We look forward to working with you again.

Victor Lam

passages.title: Museum Launches Late-Night Fridays
passages.body:
Beginning in June, the Halvorsen Art Museum will stay open until 10 P.M. every Friday. The program, called “After Hours,” will feature live music, guided tours, and a bar in the sculpture garden.

Admission after 6 P.M. will be $12, compared with the regular $18, and museum members will continue to enter free. Museum director Ingrid Solberg said the goal is to attract younger visitors who work during the day. “Many people tell us they'd love to visit but can't come before closing time,” she said.

passages.title: After Hours — June Program
passages.body: Tours are limited to 25 people; sign up at the information desk on arrival.

I'm not a member, but you are, right? Let me know which Friday works for you.

Olga

options: To request a change to the schedule

questions.prompt: If his request is accepted, when will Mr. Ellison speak?
questions.explanation: Il prendrait le créneau de Mme Desai : 13 h 00.
questions.trap: 10 h 30 est son créneau actuel, impossible à cause de son arrivée à 11 h 15.

questions.prompt: Who will speak at 10:30 if the change is made?
questions.explanation: En cas d'échange, Mme Desai, qui accepte de présenter plus tôt, prend le créneau de 10 h 30.
questions.trap: Dr Ferraz garde son créneau de 9 h.

questions.prompt: What equipment does Mr. Ellison request?
questions.explanation: « a microphone that I can wear » : un micro-cravate ou serre-tête.
questions.trap: L'enregistrement est prévu pour toutes les séances ; il ne le demande pas.

questions.explanation: « on the site of the former Riverside textile mill » : une ancienne usine textile.
questions.trap: « mill » doit être compris comme « usine ».

questions.prompt: How many apartments will be offered at reduced rents?
questions.explanation: « 180 apartments, 40 of which will be offered at below-market rents ».
questions.trap: 180 est le total ; 12 le nombre d'étages ; 5 le nombre de voix pour.

questions.prompt: Which concern raised by opponents does Ms. Mendez share?

questions.trap: Elle critique la hauteur, mais ne parle pas de la vue sur la rivière.

questions.prompt: What does Ms. Mendez suggest?
questions.explanation: « a building half the height would provide much-needed apartments ».
questions.trap: Elle n'est pas contre le projet : « I am not against new housing ».

questions.prompt: In the letter, the word “overwhelming” is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: « without overwhelming the neighborhood » : sans écraser le quartier par sa taille.
questions.trap: « flooding » est un sens littéral proche (submerger) qui ne convient pas ici.

questions.prompt: What is included in all room rates?
